imp.author: A dull resentment against his life awoke within him. Could he not escape from his little house? There was the furniture still to be paid for.

imp.generic: He suddenly understood that he had wasted his life and felt deeply alone.
imp.author: He gnawed the rectitude of his life; he felt that he had been outcast from life's feast. No one wanted him; he was outcast from life's feast.

imp.generic: She was a stern, money-minded woman who ran the household.
imp.author: She respected her husband in the same way as she respected the General Post Office, as something large, secure and fixed; and though she knew the small number of his talents she appreciated his abstract value as a male.

imp.generic: The boy was bitterly disappointed when he reached the empty bazaar.
imp.author: Gazing up into the darkness I saw myself as a creature driven and derided by vanity; and my eyes burned with anguish and anger.

imp.generic: He grew frustrated with the crying baby until he lost his temper.
imp.author: It was useless. He couldn't read. He couldn't do anything. The wailing of the child pierced the drum of his ear. It was useless, useless! He was a prisoner for life.

imp.generic: He stood waiting on the bridge, feeling happy and full of anticipation.
imp.author: The granite stone of the bridge was beginning to be warm and I began to pat it with my hands in time to an air in my head. I was very happy.

imp.generic: He was a private, orderly man who lived alone without friends.
imp.author: He had neither companions nor friends, church nor creed. He lived his spiritual life without any communion with others, visiting his relatives at Christmas and escorting them to the cemetery when they died.

imp.generic: The old woman lost the cake she had bought and was embarrassed.

imp.generic: After all his hopes, the evening left him feeling small and humiliated.
imp.author: He felt acutely the contrast between his own life and his friend's and it seemed to him unjust. What was it that stood in his way? His unfortunate timidity!
